items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: I got that idea from listening to Bobby “Blue” Bland and his horns, because he had a horn section that would basically give you that groove.

ctx.x: I saw the — the first time I saw a blues cruise advertised I had to chuckle because how can you possibly have the blues when you’re on a cruise? But then I see you wrote “Singing the Blues” on a cruise, is that right? Staring at the mirror/Singing the blues.

Yeah I wrote it on the legendary Rhythm & Blues Cruise, which I usually leave from once a year. I take my entire band. I started out duo and I think we’re up to sextet now and we’re probably going to be nine of us on stage by the end of this year, it just gets bigger. I did, I wrote “Singing the Blues” after I went to see Bobby “Blue” Bland play. And each of these bands, I think there’s like twenty bands or so on these cruises and they play, each band plays maybe twice, maybe three, four times sometimes. And I…
